shot.display: Pulse/Shot number of the initial DB.

user.display: User in which the initial data is stored.

machine_in.display: Name of the database in which the initial data is stored.

run_in.display: Run number of the initial DB.

run_out.display: Run number of the output DB.

pulse_list.display: This option enables multiple shots/runs as input.

fast_particles.display: Tick this box to take into account the energetic particles.

mpi_processes.display: How many MPI processes to use for the MPI actors.

Equilibrium_code_chease.display: Select if chease is used or not

Equilibrium_code.display: Select the equilibrium code that will be used. (only Helena for the moment)

Distributions_1.display: Either to use or not Hagis 1

Distributions_2.display: Either to use or not Hagis 2 for non linear physics.

Orbit_Finder.display: Either to use or not the finder together with hagis 2.

Stability_code.display: Which mode of LIGKA one wants to use.
